40035-book-of-monsters.title: Book Of Monsters
40035-book-of-monsters.creator: David And Marian Fairchild
40035-book-of-monsters.description: A book by David And Marian Fairchild. domesticated creatures, the flea and the mosquito. During these last two decades these have come under our control, and the flies which leave a colony of germs at every footstep will not much longer be tolerated, indeed, every creature that bites and sucks our blood or that crawls over our food and dishes has been placed under suspicion.

6861-vautrin-a-drama-in-five-acts.title: A Drama In Five Acts
6861-vautrin-a-drama-in-five-acts.creator: Unknown
6861-vautrin-a-drama-in-five-acts.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. ic sympathy which has been given him. Hugo, inasmuch as the enemies of that distinguished man have no hesitation in blackening his character.

arxiv-1907-12907.title: Comprehending deterministic and stochastic occasional uncoupling induced synchronizations through each other Preprint: anupamghosh0019@gmail.com (A. G.)
arxiv-1907-12907.creator: Anupam Ghosh, Sagar Chakraborty
arxiv-1907-12907.description: Abstract In this paper, we numerically study the stochastic and the deterministic occasional uncoupling methods of effecting identical synchronized states in low dimensional, dissipative, diffusively coupled, chaotic flows that are otherwise not synchronized when continuously coupled at the same coupling strength parameter.

arxiv-2103-05713.title: Bayesian constraints on the origin and geology of exo-planetary material using a population of externally polluted white dwarfs 2020 Bayesian constraints on the origin and geology of exo-planetary material using a population of externally polluted white dwarfs – References
arxiv-2103-05713.creator: John H. D. Harrison, Amy Bonsor, Mihkel Kama, Andrew M. Buchan, Simon Blouin, Detlev Koester
arxiv-2103-05713.description: Abstract White dwarfs that have accreted planetary bodies are a powerful probe of the bulk composition of exoplanetary material. In this paper, we present a Bayesian model to explain the abundances observed in the atmospheres of 202 DZ white dwarfs by considering the heating, geochemical differentiation, and collisional processes experienced by the planetary bodies accreted, as well as gravitational sinking.

arxiv-2107-11617.title: LAConv: Local Adaptive Convolution for Image Fusion
arxiv-2107-11617.creator: Zi-Rong Jin, Liang-Jian Deng, Tai-Xiang Jiang, Tian-Jing Zhang
arxiv-2107-11617.description: Abstract The convolution operation is a powerful tool for feature extraction and plays a prominent role in the field of computer vision. However, when targeting the pixel-wise tasks like image fusion, it would not fully perceive the particularity of each pixel in the image if the uniform convolution kernel is used on different patches.

arxiv-2207-11449.title: Generating quantum feature maps for SVM classifier
arxiv-2207-11449.creator: Bang-Shien Chen, Jann-Long Chern
arxiv-2207-11449.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Bang-Shien Chen, Jann-Long Chern. We present and compare two methods of generating quantum feature maps for quantum-enhanced support vector machine, a classifier based on kernel method, by which we can access high dimensional Hilbert space efficiently. The first method is a genetic algorithm with multi-objective fitness function using penalty method, which incorporates maximizing the accuracy of classification and minimizing the gate cost of quantum feature map’s circuit.

arxiv-2402-15613.title: Towards Efficient Active Learning in NLP via Pretrained Representations
arxiv-2402-15613.creator: Artem VysogoretsNew York UniversityCenter for Data Science amv458@nyu.edu Achintya GopalBloomberg731 Lexington Ave agopal6@bloomberg.net
arxiv-2402-15613.description: Abstract Fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) is now a common approach for text classification in a wide range of applications. When labeled documents are scarce, active learning helps save annotation efforts but requires retraining of massive models on each acquisition iteration.

arxiv-2405-01116.title: “In-Context Learning” or: How I learned to stop worrying and love “Applied Information Retrieval” Conference: Proceedings of the 47th International ACM SIGIR Conference on Research and Development in Information Retrieval; July 14–18, 2024; Washington, DC, USA Proceedings of the 47th International A
arxiv-2405-01116.creator: Andrew Parry, Debasis Ganguly, Manish Chandra
arxiv-2405-01116.description: Abstract . With the increasing ability of large language models (LLMs), in-context learning (ICL) has evolved as a new paradigm for natural language processing (NLP), where instead of fine-tuning the parameters of an LLM specific to a downstream task with labeled examples, a small number of such examples is appended to a prompt instruction for controlling the decoder’s generation process.

arxiv-2502-13500.title: Distal Causal Excursion Effects: Modeling Long-Term Effects of Time-Varying Treatments in Micro-Randomized Trials
arxiv-2502-13500.creator: Tianchen Qian
arxiv-2502-13500.description: Abstract Micro-randomized trials (MRTs) play a crucial role in optimizing digital interventions. In an MRT, each participant is sequentially randomized among treatment options hundreds of times. While the interventions tested in MRTs target short-term behavioral responses (proximal outcomes), their ultimate goal is to drive long-term behavior change (distal outcomes).

arxiv-2509-16913.title: Difficulty-Aware Score Generation for Piano Sight-Reading Journal: Knowledge-Based Systems
arxiv-2509-16913.creator: Pedro Ramoneda, Masahiro Suzuki, Akira Maezawa, Xavier Serra
arxiv-2509-16913.description: Abstract Adapting learning materials to the level of skill of a student is important in education. In the context of music training, one essential ability is sight-reading—playing unfamiliar scores at first sight—which benefits from progressive and level-appropriate practice. However, creating exercises at the appropriate level of difficulty demands significant time and effort.

pmc-11391655.title: Deep learning-based techniques for estimating high-quality full-dose positron emission tomography images from low-dose scans: a systematic review
pmc-11391655.creator: Negisa Seyyedi, Ali Ghafari, Navisa Seyyedi, Peyman Sheikhzadeh
pmc-11391655.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). This systematic review aimed to evaluate the potential of deep learning algorithms for converting low-dose Positron Emission Tomography (PET) images to full-dose PET images in different body regions. A total of 55 articles published between 2017 and 2023 by searching PubMed, Web of Science, Scopus and IEEE databases were included in this review, which utilized various deep learning models, such as generative adversarial networks and UNET, to synthesize high-quality PET images.

pmc-11425510.title: 192 Behavioural and observational analysis of ‘Be Active with Arthritis’ exercise programme to promote and maintain physical activity (PA) in people with arthritis
pmc-11425510.creator: Aoife Stephenson, Maia Harris, Rameen Khalid, Deirdre Hurley-Osing, David French, Suzanne McDonough
pmc-11425510.description: PurposeThe Irish Society of Chartered Physiotherapists (ISCP) and Arthritis Ireland (AI) developed ‘Be Active with Arthritis’ (BAWA), a physiotherapy-led, group-based exercise programme to promote PA in people with arthritis. Participant feedback suggests BAWA participants initially become more active, but many reduce PA levels after programme completion.

pmc-11483907.title: Selective Separation of Thiophene Derivatives Using Metal–Organic Frameworks-Based Membranes
pmc-11483907.creator: Aigerim Ospanova, Kyran Kassym, Dana Kanzhigitova, Talgat Orazbek, Aida Ardakkyzy, Zhexenbek Toktarbay, Nurxat Nuraje
pmc-11483907.description: The removal of sulfur compounds, particularly thiophene derivatives, from oil is crucial due to concerns about environmental issues. Therefore, the deep desulfurization of transportation fuels is currently an urgent problem, and numerous attempts have been made in this direction. Membrane-based desulfurization can be a good alternative to the traditional hydrodesulfurization method, which has several limitations.

pmc-11589238.title: Effects of Glaucoma Treatment on Ocular Surface and Tear Functions: Comparison of Trabeculectomy and Antiglaucoma Drops
pmc-11589238.creator: Abdussamet Mermer, Özer Dursun, Öznur Bucak, Hamide Sayar, Fatma Merve Bektaş, Pınar Eröz, Ayça Yılmaz
pmc-11589238.description: ObjectivesTo investigate tear function and ocular surface disease (OSD) findings in patients with glaucoma who received antiglaucoma medication in one eye and trabeculectomy surgery in the other eye.Materials and MethodsThe patient group included 38 eyes of 19 patients who had undergone trabeculectomy surgery with mitomycin C (MMC) treatment in one eye at least 6 months prior.

pmc-11621736.title: Clinical, biochemical, and genetic study of TACE/TNF-α/ACE signaling pathway in pediatric COVID-19 infection
pmc-11621736.creator: Ahmed El-Abd Ahmed, Sawsan M.A. Abuhamdah, Mohammed H. Hassan, Nagwan I. Rashwan, Eman A. Abd-Elmawgood, Haggagy Mansour, Hoda S. Sherkawy, Shymaa G. Rizk
pmc-11621736.description: Background Pediatric patients infected with coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) have unique clinical characteristics. Tumor necrosis factor (TNF) is a proinflammatory cytokine that greatly contributes to tumor pathogenesis.Purpose To describe the presenting characteristics of COVID-19 infection among pediatric patients, and investigate the possible role of the TNF-α signaling pathway.

pmc-12413000.title: Construction of indicator system of tourism professional skills evaluation system in the application-oriented Universities - A case study in Fujian, China
pmc-12413000.creator: Hung-Lung Lin, Xiang Li, Jia-Min Zhang
pmc-12413000.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). This study aims to establish a “Tourism Professional Skills Evaluation System in Application-Oriented Universities” to bridge the gap between industry requirements and traditional curricula. In response to the tourism sector’s rapid growth and shifting market demands, this study employ the Modified Delphi Method (MDM) and Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) to identify and weight five core competency domains: basic professional knowledge and skills, professional related knowledge and skills, interpersonal and self-development skills, physical fitness, as well as cultural and ethical rule of ethics

pmc-12464305.title: Effects of oral glucose tolerance test on microvascular and autonomic nervous system regulation in young healthy individuals
pmc-12464305.creator: Lana Kralj, Tadej Battelino, Helena Lenasi
pmc-12464305.description: Acute elevations in blood glucose can influence microvascular function and autonomic nervous system (ANS) reactivity, both implicated in cardiometabolic risk. We assessed the effects of oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) on microvascular and ANS physiological responses in healthy young individuals.

pmc-12504379.title: Is technological-assisted leg axis alignment reliable in total knee arthroplasty with varus–valgus deformities?
pmc-12504379.creator: Daniel Hernandez-Vaquero, Alfonso Noriega-Fernandez, Sergio Roncero-Gonzalez
pmc-12504379.description: PurposeComputer-assisted systems improve conventional instrumentation in normalizing the axis of the limb in frontal deformities. The performance of a postoperative X-ray has been questioned to verify this axis, assuming that it can be replaced by the final image that appears on the system monitor. The objective of this work is to verify whether both axes are similar.

pmc-12563026.title: Transcriptional Profiling Defines Unique Subtypes of Transit Amplifying Neural Progenitors Within the Neonatal Mouse Subventricular Zone
pmc-12563026.creator: Rebecca Zaritsky, Ekta Kumari, Fernando Janczur Velloso, Alexander Lemenze, Seema Husain, Steven W. Levison
pmc-12563026.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). While significant progress has been made in understanding the heterogeneity of Neural Stem Cells (NSCs), our understanding of similar heterogeneity among the more abundant transit amplifying progenitors is lagging. Our work on the neural progenitors (NPs) of the neonatal subventricular zone (SVZ) began over a decade ago, when we used antibodies to the four antigens, CD133, LeX, CD140a, and NG2 to perform Fluorescence-activated cell sorting to classify subsets of the neonatal mouse SVZ as either multi-potential (MP1, MP2, MP3, MP4 and PFMPs),

pmc-12639468.title: Signaling pathway alterations in hearts of a porcine model harboring a β-myosin heavy chain (MYH7-R403Q) gene variant☆
pmc-12639468.creator: Chad M Warren, David M Ryba, Gail E Geist, Aileen Castro Coronado, Beata M Wolska, Paul H Goldspink, R John Solaro
pmc-12639468.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The disease-causing myosin variant (MYH7-403Q) is linked to hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM). We carried out a research study of signaling pathways in heart samples from control wild-type (WT) GE Yucatán mini-pigs and their littermates harboring the gene variant, MYH7-R403Q. Our approach permits the determination of adverse signaling pathways involved in different regions of a translationally relevant heart without the effects of intervention.

pmc-12644811.title: Urinary biochemical ecology reveals microbiome-metabolite interactions and metabolic markers of recurrent urinary tract infection
pmc-12644811.creator: Michael L. Neugent, Neha V. Hulyalkar, Debasish Ghosh, Ceejay N. Saenz, Philippe E. Zimmern, Vladimir Shulaev, Nicole J. De Nisco
pmc-12644811.description: Recurrent urinary tract infections (rUTIs) are a major clinical challenge, and their increasing prevalence underscores the need to define host-microbiome interactions underlying susceptibility. How the urinary microbiota engages with the biochemical environment of the urogenital tract is yet to be fully defined.

pmc-12842114.title: Physicochemical and Antioxidant Alterations of Modified and Free Epigallocatechin Gallate Under Thermal Treatment in Air and Vacuum
pmc-12842114.creator: Lianjing Yu, Zi Deng, Masato Nakagawa, Shanshan Zheng, Jun-ichiro Jo, Tomonari Tanaka, Yoshitomo Honda
pmc-12842114.description: Epigallocatechin gallate (EGCG)—the most abundant catechin in green tea—is a promising component of advanced composite biomaterials. The pharmacological activity of EGCG is typically attenuated upon thermal processing, although the exact effects of heating free and modified EGCG in air and vacuum are unknown.

pmc-13188796.title: Non-pharmacological interventions for improving sleep quality in adults aged 50 years and older: a systematic review and network meta-analysis
pmc-13188796.creator: Junyu Wang, Yuan Yuan, Ying Bai, Bopeng Qiu, Yiqi Li, Tao Wang, Fuhong Wang, Zhongli Wang, Zhiyu Xiong, Yong Yang, Jie Zhuang
pmc-13188796.description: BackgroundSleep disturbances are highly prevalent among adults aged 50 years and older and are associated with substantial public health burdens, including impaired cognitive function, reduced quality of life, and increased healthcare utilization. Although non-pharmacological treatments (NPTs) are increasingly recommended as first-line strategies, their comparative effectiveness and optimal implementation characteristics remain unclear.

pmc-13568817.title: Comparative effectiveness and safety of risankizumab vs ustekinumab in patients with Crohn’s disease: a propensity score–matched multicenter retrospective cohort study
pmc-13568817.creator: Bisher Sawaf, Umberto Battistin, Mohammed Abu-Rumaileh, Kyrillos Mahrous Gerges, Yusuf Hallak, Shahem Abbarh, Elias Batikh, Nwal Hadaki, Muhammed Elhadi, Miguel Regueiro, Mohammad Al-Haddad
pmc-13568817.description: BackgroundIn the SEQUENCE trial, risankizumab was non-inferior for clinical remission and superior for endoscopic remission compared to ustekinumab in anti-TNF-exposed Crohn’s disease (CD) patients. Given unclear results in real-world settings, we aimed to evaluate whether these findings translate to real-world advanced therapy-exposed and naïve CD cohorts.
